result.brief: 提出统一视觉-触觉世界模型 PhysCanvas，共享视频 VAE 与生成骨干，用运动图像做空间对齐动作条件，并以一致性后训练支撑机器人策略评估与 GRPO 后训练。
result.reason: Action-conditioned visuo-tactile world model sharing a video VAE and generative backbone; main contribution is world modeling plus policy evaluation, so primary world_model with application secondary.
